name: Roth 401(k) Conversion Calculator
meta_title: Roth 401(k) Conversion Calculator: In-Plan Rollover Tax
meta_description: Estimate the 2026 tax on rolling pre-tax 401(k) money into your Roth 401(k), spread over one or more years, and compare it with keeping it pre-tax.
subtitle: Estimate the tax on moving pre-tax 401(k) money into the plan’s Roth account, in one year or spread over several, and see whether rolling over or keeping it pre-tax leaves you more after tax when you start withdrawals.
